notes.title: Demo version is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Destroyer in Miraculous Storm. Demo version is out Now!



You can experience following content in Demo version:

Main gameplay up to Stage 3 (with 4 different difficulties available).

3 main characters.

Music Room (basic function)



Demo version does not represent the quality of the final version.

If you have any comments or suggestions, feel free to post on the Steam discussion.

We look forward to your feedback!
